text: Suno kay Bombo Joseph Rivera, Bombo International Correspondent sa Qatar, sa amo nga meeting ginpamatian ang tanan nga concerns sang mga tiglawas sang Filipino communities.
english: According to Bombo Joseph Rivera, Bombo International Correspondent in Qatar, the meeting heard all the concerns of the representatives of the Filipino communities.

text: Ginpasiguro naman sang amo nga mga ahensya sang gobyerno ang kahandaan nga magresponde sa kinahanglanon sang masobra sa 200,000 ka mga Filipinos nga nagaistar kag nagatrabaho sa Qatar.
english: These government agencies assured their readiness to respond to the needs of more than 200,000 Filipinos living and working in Qatar.

text: Ginbuyagyag sang American singer nga si Britney Spears nga may yara ini sang brain damage.
english: American singer Britney Spears has revealed that she has brain damage.

text: Sa iya social media account, ginpahayag sini nga magluwas nga ginkakas ang iya mga pakpak, may yara man siya sang brain damage pila ka tuig na ang nakaligad.
english: On his social media account, he said that besides having his wings removed, he also suffered brain damage a few years ago.

text: Wala ginpaathag sang singer kon ano ang iya buot silingon kon diin ang iya mga pakpak sang may pilas siya sa iya abaga.
english: The singer did not explain what he meant by where his wings were when he had a shoulder injury.

text: Sang 2019, nagsuprerher man siya sang mental health problem nga ginapatihan gintunaan sang iya brain damage.
english: In 2019, he also suffered from a mental health problem that is believed to have been caused by his brain damage.

text: Matandaan nga gin-ako man sang singer nga naga-inom ini sang makahulubog nga ilimnon samtang nagabusong kag padayon nga ginabulong.
english: The singer also admitted to drinking alcohol while pregnant and is undergoing treatment.

text: 𝗜𝗟𝗢𝗜𝗟𝗢 𝗖𝗜𝗧𝗬—Gina-propose sang Iloilo City Health Office (CHO) ang P7,040,000 nga budget sa Iloilo City Council para sa state of calamity bangud man sa mataas nga numero sang dengue cases sa syudad.
english: Iloilo City Health Office (CHO) is proposing a P7,040,000 budget to the Iloilo City Council for the state of calamity due to the high number of dengue cases in the city.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Annabelle Tang, Head sang Iloilo City Health Office, iya ginpahayag nga ang proposed nga pondo ang gamiton sa pag-procure sang mga testing kits and supply.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Annabelle Tang, Head of the Iloilo City Health Office, said the proposed fund will be used to procure testing kits and supplies.

text: Suno kay Tang, ibakal man ini sang mga misting equipment kag mga bulong batok sa lamok nga ipangatag sa tagsa ka mga barangay sa Iloilo City.
english: According to Tang, it will also purchase misting equipment and mosquito repellents to be distributed to each barangay in Iloilo City.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga tinutuyo man sang talatapan nga mapadasig nga mapanubo ang numero sang mga nagpositibo sa dengue.
english: He said the office also aims to quickly reduce the number of dengue positives.

text: Gin-ako naman sang natungdan nga anay na nga ginalantaw sang talatapan ang dengue outbreak antes ginrekomenda sang City Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council ang state of calamity.
english: He acknowledged that the office was already monitoring the dengue outbreak before the City Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council recommended the state of calamity.

text: Natalana naman nga iplastar bwas nga adlaw ang breakdowns sa kon diin pagid gamiton ang nasambit nga pondo.
english: The breakdowns on where the fund will be used are scheduled to be laid out tomorrow.

text: Santo pinakabag-o nga record sang City Health Office, sugod sang Enero tubtob Agosto 27, 2024, naglab-ot na sa 903 ang kaso sang dengue, kon sa diin apat na ang na-record nga napatay.
english: According to the latest records of the City Health Office, from January to August 27, 2024, there were 903 dengue cases, with four deaths recorded.

text: Ginpabutyag ni House Speaker Martin Romualdez nga wala sang pulitikal nga tinutuyo ang impeachment complaint batok kay Vice President Sara Duterte.
english: House Speaker Martin Romualdez said the impeachment complaint against Vice President Sara Duterte has no political motive.

text: Suno kay Romualdez, ginpahayag sini nga ginatuman lang sang Kamara ang mandato sini sa idalum sang Konstitusyon, kag may nagakaigo nga basehan kag dokumento ang ginpasaka nga reklamo.
english: According to Romualdez, he said the House is only fulfilling its mandate under the Constitution, and the complaint filed has proper grounds and documents.

text: Ginpakamalaot man ni Romualdez ang desisyon sang Senado nga i-archive ang complaint bisan wala pa sang final nga desisyon ang Korte Suprema, kag ginbuyagyag nga nagsumiter na sila sang Motion for Reconsideration.
english: Romualdez also condemned the Senate's decision to archive the complaint even though the Supreme Court has not yet made a final decision, and revealed that they have already submitted a Motion for Reconsideration.

text: Dugang pa niya, indi ini pagpang-atake kundi kabahin sang pagsiguro nga may accountability ang mga opisyal sang gobyerno.
english: He added that this was not an attack but part of ensuring accountability of government officials.

text: Ginpat-ud sini nga indi ini away sa Senado kundi pagtindog sa Konstitusyon kag interes sang pumuluyo.
english: He assured that this is not a fight in the Senate but a stand for the Constitution and the interests of the people.

text: Indi basta-basta nga mga kunsekwensya ang atubangon sang mga tawo nga madakpan nga may kaangtanan sa iligal nga droga.
english: People caught in connection with illegal drugs will face no light consequences.

text: Apang paano abi kun ang madakpan indi tawo?
english: But what if the catch is not human?

text: Sa Pococi, Costa Rica, arestado ang isa ka kuring bangud sa krimen nga pagdala sang illegal drugs sa sulod sang presuhan.
english: In Pococi, Costa Rica, a cat was arrested for the crime of bringing illegal drugs into a prison.

text: Nagduda ang mga opisyal sa Pococi Penitentiary sang nakit-an ang kuring nga nagalakat-lakat kag may nakaputos nga tela sa iya lawas.
english: Officials at Pococi Penitentiary became suspicious when the cat was found wandering around with a cloth wrapped around its body.

text: Gingunting nila ang tela kag didto nakit-an ang mga pakete sang marijuana, 70 gramos sang cocaine paste, kag duha ka papel nga ginagamit nga drug paraphernalia.
english: They cut open the cloth and found packets of marijuana, 70 grams of cocaine paste, and two pieces of paper used as drug paraphernalia.

text: Ginbansagan ang kuring nga si “Narcomishi,” ukon “Narco Kitten,” kag sang ulihi gintugyan ini sa National Animal Health Service (SENASA).
english: The cat was nicknamed “Narcomishi,” or “Narco Kitten,” and was later turned over to the National Animal Health Service (SENASA).

text: Ginpasalig sang awtoridad nga maayo ang pagtatap sang pasilidad sa kuring apisar pa nga may record ini sa illegal drugs.
english: The authorities assured that the facility is taking good care of the dog despite his record of illegal drugs.

text: Sandig sa otoridad, may nauna na sila na-encounter nga kaso sang 2018 kun sa diin kuring man ang nadakpan nga magpalusot sang mga kontrabando.
english: According to the authorities, they have previously encountered a case in 2018 where a dog was also caught smuggling smuggled goods.

text: Sang amo nga tuig, ang ginpadala sa kuring amo ang earphone, charger, kag cellphone nga may yara pa sang extra battery nga ginalantaw tuyo nga ipagamit sa preso.
english: That year, the cat was sent an earphone, a charger, and a cellphone with an extra battery that was apparently intended to be used by the inmate.

text: Ginatinguhaan sang Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB) Region 6 nga mahatag na sa mga drivers kag operators sang Western Visayas ang fuel subsidy antes pa nga matapos ang bulan sang Marso.
english: The Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB) Region 6 is trying to get the fuel subsidy to the drivers and operators of Western Visayas before the end of March.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay LTFRB 6 Atty. Joscet Abellar, Chief of Transportation Development Office, iya ginpahayag nga ginapreparahan pa nila ang iban nga kinahanglanon nga dokumento para sa sa subsidiya halin sa Department of Transportation (DOTr), apang natigayon naman nga mapasa ang mga requirements sa Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD).
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, LTFRB 6 Atty. Joscet Abellar, Chief of Transportation Development Office, said they are still preparing other necessary documents for the subsidy from the Department of Transportation (DOTr), but managed to submit the requirements to the Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD).

text: Suno sa iya, ang subsidiya nga igahatag sang Department of Transportation amo ang ipaagi sa E-wallet agud nga mas mapadasig ang paghatag sang subsidiya para sa mga drivers kag operators.
english: He said the subsidy to be provided by the Department of Transportation will be through the E-wallet to speed up the distribution of subsidies for drivers and operators.

text: Dugang pa ni Abellar, madasig man nga naghatag sang mga kinahanglanon nga mga requirements ang mga beneficiaries, rason nga possible nga mabatun gid sang mga ini ang subsidiya halin sa gobyerno.
english: Abellar added that the beneficiaries quickly provided the necessary requirements, which is why it is possible that they will receive the subsidy from the government.

text: Nagsaka sa ikalima nga pwesto ang Pilipinas nga may 30 ka medalya sa pinakaulihi nga tally sang 2025 SEA Games subong nga adlaw, Disyembre 12.
english: The Philippines rose to fifth place with 30 medals in the latest tally of the 2025 SEA Games today, December 12.

text: Nagapanguna sa gihapon ang Thailand sa medal haul nga may kabug-usan nga 69 ka medalya lakip na ang 37 ka gold.
english: Thailand still leads the medal haul with a total of 69 medals including 37 gold.

text: Nagapangaduha naman ang Vietnam nga may 10 ka gold, 7 ka silver kag 23 ka bronze medals.
english: Vietnam came in second with 10 gold, 7 silver and 23 bronze medals.

text: Yara naman sa ulihi nga pwesto ang Timor Leste nga may duha ka bronze medals.
english: Timor Leste is in last place with two bronze medals.

text: GINAPANUGYAN ni former Supreme Court Senior Associate Justice Antonio Carpio nga magpasaka ang Filipinas sing kaso sa International Tribunal agud mapat-ud kon tubtub diin gid ang “territorial right” sang China sa South China Sea.
english: Former Supreme Court Senior Associate Justice Antonio Carpio has suggested that the Philippines file a case with the International Tribunal to determine the extent of China's “territorial right” in the South China Sea.

text: Why not?
english: Why not?

text: In fact, ang China mismo wala makaseguro tubtub diin gid ang dulonan sang iya teritoryo sa kadagatan.
english: In fact, China itself has not been able to secure the exact extent of its maritime territorial boundaries.

text: Kon pat-ud sini ang dulonan sang iya “territorial right” sa South China Sea, ti ngaa galiwat-liwat ang iya pensar parti sini?
english: If it is certain of the boundaries of its territorial right in the South China Sea, then why does it keep thinking about it?

text: Sang sini lang gani ginliwat sini ang iya daan nine-dash line claim sa 10-dash line.
english: It even recently revised its old nine-dash line claim to a 10-dash line.

text: Gapati gani ang iban nga basi madugangan pa ang claim sini sa 11-dash line kag 12-dash line.
english: Some even believe that it might increase its claim to the 11-dash line and 12-dash line.

text: Sining ulihi lang man gani, gin-islan sini ang iya daan nga mapa kag naghimo sing bag-o nga mapa nga nagasakop na sang pila ka bahin sang 200-nautical mile nga Exclusive Economic Zone sang Filipinas kag iban pa nga pungsod sa Southeast Asia.
english: Recently, it replaced its old map with a new one that now covers parts of the 200-nautical mile Exclusive Economic Zone of the Philippines and other Southeast Asian countries.

text: Ang Paracel Islands, nga sakop man sa mapa nga ini, isa ka archipelago nga natung-an sang China kag Vietnam.
english: The Paracel Islands, also included in this map, are an archipelago between China and Vietnam.

text: Gina-claim ini sang China pero gina-claim man ini sang Vietnam, meaning dapat husayon pa ini kon kay sin-o nga teritoryo ini.
english: China claims it but Vietnam also claims it, meaning it has to be settled on whose territory it is.

text: Ang claim sang mga SEA nga mga pungsod sa ila 200-nautical mile Exclusive Economic Zone nahusayan na ini sang International Tribune sa pagdaug sang kaso sang Filipinas batok sa China sadtong 2016.
english: The claim of the SEA countries to their 200-nautical mile Exclusive Economic Zone has been settled by the International Tribune in winning the Philippines' case against China in 2016.

text: Ugaling wala sini gina-recognize ang desisyon sining tribuna nga gintukod sang United Nations agud ma-settle ang mga international disputes, making China nga isa ka “rogue member”, kon ang abyan naton nga si Pedro pa ang magtawag sa China.
english: But it does not recognize the decision of this tribunal established by the United Nations to settle international disputes, making China a “rogue member”, if our friend Pedro calls China.

text: Nagahatag na gani ini sing kakulba sa sining mga pungsod nga basi mang-agaw pa ini sang dugang nga mga isla katulad sang pag-agaw sini sadtong 2012 sang Scarborough Shoal nga yara sa sulod sang EEZ sang Filipinas.
english: This is even causing concern among these countries that it might seize more islands as it seized in 2012 the Scarborough Shoal within the Philippine EEZ.

text:
***

In fact, ang ginahimo sini nga pang-harass sa aton mga mangingisda kag coastguard sa ila pagbantay kag pagtuman sang ila mga hilikuton sa sulod sang aton EEZ gahatag gid sing daku nga pagpati sang handom sini nga agawon pa ang pila ka isla sa sulod sang aton EEZ, kag sang iban pa nga pungsod sa Southeast Asia, nga nagalakip sang Indonesia, Malaysia, Borneo, kag Vietnam.
english:
***

In fact, its harassment of our fishermen and coastguard in their guarding and carrying out their activities within our EEZ gives great credence to its desire to seize more islands within our EEZ, and other countries in Southeast Asia, including Indonesia, Malaysia, Borneo, and Vietnam.

text: Paagi syempre sa pwersa sa padayon sini nga pamahog kag pang-harass sa pila ka isla sakop sang aton EEZ, nga lakip dira ang Pag-asa Island nga madugay na ginapuy-an sang madamo nga mga Filipino.
english: By force of course in its continued threats and harassment on several islands within our EEZ, including Pag-asa Island which has long been inhabited by many Filipinos.

text: Ang Pag-asa kag kaiping sini nga mga isla pwede na gani ma-consider nga archipelago nga sakop sang Filipinas.
english: Pag-asa and its neighboring islands can even be considered an archipelago of the Philippines.

text: Kag bisan pa sang pasalig sang Estados Unidos sang pagbulig sa Filipinas sa tion nga magpakita ang China sang aksyon militar batok sa Filipinas.
english: And despite the US assurance of helping the Philippines in case China shows military action against the Philippines.

text:
***

Sa karon gina-claim sang China ang halos 90% – 80% halin sa mainland kag 10% sa gina-claim nga EEZ sini halin sa mga isla nga kuno sakop pa niya, lakip ang mga artificial islands.
english:
***

China currently claims nearly 90% – 80% from the mainland and 10% of its claimed EEZ from islands that are still under its jurisdiction, including artificial islands.

text: Gina-assert man sang China nga isa ini ka “archipelago” nga gahatag poder sa iya sa mga kadagatan sa palibut sang mga isla,  samtang wala man ini ma-recognize sang United Nations bisan paagi lang sa pagpasaka sang kasubong nga claim sa UN.
english: China also asserts that it is an “archipelago” that gives it power over the seas around the islands, while the United Nations has not recognized it even by filing such a claim with the UN.

text: Samtang sige ang pagtukod sini sang mga artificial nga infrastructura sa galutaw nga mga kabatuhan kag magagmay nga mga isla kag nagapasanyog sang iya military facilities sa sining mga man-made outposts.
english: Meanwhile, it continues to build artificial infrastructures on floating rocks and small islands and upgrades its military facilities to these man-made outposts.

text: Padayon man ang pag-backup sini sang iya claim paagi sang pag-patrolya sang iya coastguard, maritime militia kag fishing fleet.
english: It also continues to back up its claim through the patrolling of its coastguard, maritime militia and fishing fleet.

text: Samtang, ang mga pungsod nga naga-claim sang bahin sang SCS kag naga-reject sang nine-dash (karon 10-dash) line nagasiling nga naga-encroach ini sa ila mga teritoryo sa idalom sang United Nations Convention of the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS), labi na gid sa ila EEZs.
english: Meanwhile, countries that claim part of the SCS and reject the nine-dash (now 10-dash) line say it encroaches on their territories under the United Nations Convention of the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS), most notably their EEZs.

text: Ang Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) madugay na gani nagahikot sang Code of Conduct agud ma-ibsan ang tension sa ila mga claims.
english: The Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) has long been working on a Code of Conduct to ease tensions over its claims.

text: Sugod sadtong 2002 wala pa ugaling matigayon ini luas sa isa ka preliminary code nga na-aprubahan.
english: Since 2002, however, it has not been available except for a preliminary code that has been approved.

text: Ang problema gihapon dira, sa aton pagpati, amo nga indi gid magpasupil ang China sa iya luyag matabo nga indi man luyag mahatag sang SEA nations.
english: The problem here, in our opinion, is that China will never give in to what it wants to happen that the SEA nations do not want to give.

text: Gani dapat magpakaisug gid kita agud pangapinan sang aton kabuhi ang aton kinamatarong sa aton EEZ agud indi ma-dislokar ang aton sovereign rights diri, notwithstanding nga super power ang China, kag upod sa pasalig nga bulig sang Estados Unidos sa idalom sang aton Mutual Defense Pact./PN
english: Therefore, we must be very brave to defend our rights in our EEZ so that our sovereign rights are not dislocated here, notwithstanding that China is a super power, and with the assured assistance of the United States under our Mutual Defense Pact./PN

text: Nagdangat na sa P17.71 trillion ang utang sang Pilipinas sa pagtakop sang 2025.
english: The Philippines' debt will reach P17.71 trillion by the end of 2025.

text: Sandig ini sa data nga ginpaguwa sang Bureau of the Treasury.
english: This is based on data released by the Bureau of the Treasury.

text: Suno sa ahensya, ang utang sang gobyerno sa pagtapos sang Disyembre 2025 ang nagtaas pa sang 10.32% ukon P1.66 trillion halin sa utang nga P16.05 trillion sang Disyembre 2024.
english: According to the agency, the government's debt at the end of December 2025 increased by 10.32% or P1.66 trillion from the debt of P16.05 trillion in December 2024.

text: Lapaw man ang kantidad sa ceiling ukon ang maximum lang kuntani nga utangon sang gobyerno nga amo ang P17.36 trillion.
english: The amount exceeds the ceiling or the maximum that the government should have borrowed which is P17.36 trillion.

text: Isa sa ginrason sang ahensya amo ang epekto sang pagluya sang balor sang Peso batok sa US dollar kag third currencies lakip na ang Euro kag ang Japanese Yen.
english: One of the reasons cited by the agency was the impact of the depreciation of the Peso against the US dollar and third currencies including the Euro and the Japanese Yen.

text: Gindugang man sang ahensya nga kadam-an sa utang sang Pilipinas ukon 68.4% ang naghalin man mismo diri sa pungsod.
english: The agency added that most of the Philippines' debt or 68.4% comes from the country itself.

text: Ang foreign debt ukon ang utang naman sa luwas sang pungsod naglab-ot sa P5.59 trillion nga mas mataas sang 9.19% halin sa P5.12 trillion sa katapusan sang 2024.
english: Foreign debt reached P5.59 trillion, up 9.19% from P5.12 trillion at the end of 2024.

text: Sandig sa Budget of Expenditures and Sources of Financing, ginalantaw nga subong nga tuig,magatimbuok pa sa P19.057 trillion ang sovereign debt sang Pilipinas.
english: According to the Budget of Expenditures and Sources of Financing, the Philippines' sovereign debt is expected to reach P19.057 trillion this year.

text: Nabaton na ni Vice President Sara Duterte ang imbitasyon sang House Committee on Justice nga magtambong sa impeachment hearing sa masunod nga Mierkules, Marso 25.
english: Vice President Sara Duterte has accepted the invitation of the House Committee on Justice to attend the impeachment hearing next Wednesday, March 25.

text: Suno kay Committee Chair Rep.
english: According to Committee Chair Rep.

text: Gerville Luistro, may ara sang patigayunon nga regular meeting ang panel nga maga-umpisa sang alas 10 sa aga.
english: Gerville Luistro, the panel will hold a regular meeting starting at 10 am.

text: Ginpangabay man sang Committee nga magtambong si Duterte sang personal bilang respondent sa impeachment complaints nga gin-file nanday Reverend Father Joel Saballa kag Atty. Nathaniel G. Cabrera kag iban pa.
english: The Committee also requested Duterte to appear personally as a respondent to the impeachment complaints filed by Reverend Father Joel Saballa and Atty. Nathaniel G. Cabrera et al.

text: Mahimo i-coordinate ni Duterte sa secretariat sang Committee ang kumpirmasyon sang iya pagtambong.
english: Duterte can coordinate with the Committee's secretariat for confirmation of his attendance.

text: Nahibaluan nga duha sa apat ka reklamo ang nagapabilin sa hurisdiksyon sang Committee on Justice, samtang ang isa gin-set aside bangud sa nalapas nga one-year bar rule kag ang isa gin-withdraw sang nag-file sini.
english: Two of the four complaints remain within the jurisdiction of the Committee on Justice, while one was set aside for violating the one-year bar rule and the other was withdrawn by the person who filed it.

text: Sa Marso 25, nakatalana ang procedural framework sang impeachment proceedings kag opisyal nga pagbukas sang diskusyon sa mga reklamo batok kay Duterte.
english: On March 25, the procedural framework of the impeachment proceedings and the official opening of the discussion on the complaints against Duterte are scheduled.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang mga alegasyon sa impeachment complaints batok kay Duterte nagalakip sang betrayal of public trust, pagpanuhol sini, graft and corruption, lakip na ang ginaalegar nga misuse sang P612 milyon nga confidential funds.
english: It is known that the allegations in the impeachment complaints against Duterte include betrayal of public trust, bribery, graft and corruption, including the alleged misuse of P612 million confidential funds.

text: UPOD kita sa tindog ni Presidente Marcos Jr.,  sa iya pagpanguna sang aton foreign relations, nga mag-“abstain”, ukon indi magboto “Yes” man ukon “No”, sa resolusyon sang UN General Assembly agud mag-untat (ceasefire) na sa pag-inaway ang Israel kag Hamas militants nga nagagahum sa Gaza.
english: We are with the position of President Marcos Jr., in his leadership of our foreign relations, to “abstain”, or not vote “Yes” or “No”, on the resolution of the UN General Assembly to cease fire between Israel and Hamas militants who rule Gaza.

text: Ang iya rason, ugaling, basi indi man magtugma sa aton rason.
english: His reason, however, might not match ours.

text: Sa UN Resolution vote, 120 ang nagboto pabor (Yes) sa ceasefire, 14 ang nagkontra (No) kag 45, lakip ang Filipinas, ang nag-“abstain”.
english: In the UN Resolution vote, 120 voted in favor (Yes) of the ceasefire, 14 against (No) and 45, including the Philippines, abstained.

text: Bag-o sini, apat gid ka beses nga gintulod sang UN Security Council ang”ceasefire” apang gin-veto ini gihapon sang United States, gani indi ini mapatuman.
english: Before that, the UN Security Council pushed the ceasefire four times but the United States vetoed it, so it could not be implemented.

text: Tungod sini nagpasar na sang ceasefire resolution ang UN General Assembly.
english: The UN General Assembly has passed a ceasefire resolution.

text: Wala ugaling  sing police power ini agud ipatuman ining resolusyon, gani sige lang ang pag-ilinaway tubtub seguro sila na lang nga duha mag-desisyon nga untaton na ini.
english: However, it does not have the police power to enforce this resolution, so the fighting will continue until they both decide to stop it.

text: Ayhan paagi sa isa ka “truce” para sa temporaryo anay nga pag-untat sang inaway ukon sa isa na ka final nga “treaty” para sa madugayon na nga kalinong sa tunga sang Israel kag Gaza.
english: Perhaps through a truce for a temporary ceasefire or a final treaty for a long-standing peace between Israel and Gaza.

text: Tani indi man pareho ka dugay ining ila gyera sa Great War sa Europe nga natapos lang pagkatapos sang pitu (7) ka tuig paagi sa Treaty of Paris.
english: I wish their war was not as long as the Great War in Europe which ended after seven (7) years with the Treaty of Paris.

text:
***

Ang brutal nga pag-atake sang Hamas pasulod mismo sang Israel sadtong Oktubre 7 nagpatay gid sang mga 1,400 ka tawo.
english:
***

The brutal Hamas attack right into Israel on October 7 actually killed about 1,400 people.

text: Wala sing ginpasin-o, soldado man ukon sibilyan, tigulang man ukon bata lakip ang mga lapsag.
english: No one was spared, soldier or civilian, old or young, including infants.

text: Kag kon diin man sila makita kag masapwan nga gaharay-ad tadtad sang bala, napugutan sing ulo, kag na-rape nga mga menor de edad.
english: And wherever they are seen and found, they are scattered with bullet fragments, beheaded, and raped minors.

text: Nagdala pa sila sang mga 200 ka hostages agud seguro gamiton sa ila pagpanagang sa pagbalos nga atake sang Israel, nga pila sini naluas na sang Israel.
english: They also took about 200 hostages to probably use in their defense against Israeli retaliatory attacks, some of which Israel had already rescued.

text: Tungod sa sining makangilidlis nga “invasion” sang Hamas indi na katingalahan kon ngaa terorista ang tawag sa ila.
english: Given this horrific “invasion” by Hamas it is no wonder why they are called terrorists.

text: Ginsabat naman ini sang Israel gamit ang ila bug-os nga pwersa sa hangin, sa kalalawran kag sang ground forces nga sang sini lang nagsulod na sa  Gaza.
english: Israel responded with all its air, naval and ground forces that recently entered Gaza.

text: Samtang nagabalos man ang Hamas halin sa Gaza sing missile attack kag bombardiyo nga may bulig sang mga Hezzbollah terrorists sa border sang Lebanon.
english: Meanwhile, Hamas retaliated from Gaza with missile attacks and bombings with the help of Hezzbollah terrorists on the Lebanese border.

text: Sa sige pagbayluhanay sang pang-atake, naglab-ut na ang nagkalamatay sa mga 8,000 halin sa pihak kag pihak sugod sang nagpatuman na ang Israel sang malaparon nga pag-atake sa Gaza tubtub subong.
english: In the continuous exchange of attacks, the death toll from both sides has reached about 8,000 since Israel launched a widespread attack on Gaza until now.

text:
***

Tungod naga-gyera na sila, kag tungod sa sobra-sobra nga gut-gut nila sa isa kag isa, indi mo na matuod mapunggan pa sila sa ila gyera bisan pa sa pagsaway na sang na-konsyensya na nga mga kaalyado kag kasilingan nila.
english:
***

text: Hinali nga nagluntad ang power outage sa Department of Energy (DOE) samtang ginapatigayon ang press conference kun sa diin gina-istoryahan ang bastante nga suplay sang kuryente sa pungsod.

text: Naglab-ot pa sa dies minutos ang kalawigon sang pagka-utod sang suplay sang kuryente antes ini nabalik sa building.
english: The power outage lasted for ten minutes before it was restored to the building.

text: Paathag ni Energy Secretary Raphael Lotilla, isa lamang ka “isolated incident” ang natabo nga power outage.
english: Energy Secretary Raphael Lotilla explained that the power outage was only an “isolated incident”.

text: Dugang sini, ang naapektuhan lamang amo ang Building 5 sang Philippine National Oil Company sa sulod sang DOE compound sa Taguig City.
english: He added that only Building 5 of the Philippine National Oil Company inside the DOE compound in Taguig City was affected.

text: Naglahog man ini nga posible nga wala nasarangan sang electrical infrastructure nga ma-handle ang electrical needs sang equipment sang mga journalists nga yara sa hulot kun sa diin may presscon.

text: “I think this particular room… the power demand surge from all of your equipment.
english: “I think this particular room… the power demand surges from all of your equipment.

text: So we will take that into account for next time,” pahayag sang energy secretary kasunod sang hitabo.

text: AKIG gid ang aton abyan nga si Pedro, kag kita man, sa nadiskubrihan sang Philippine Coast Guard nga malapad gali nga lugar sa 200-mile Exclusive Economic Zone sang Filipinas sa West Philippine Sea kon diin madamo nga mga koral (corals) ang nahalitan gid.
english: OUR friend Pedro, and we, are very angry at the Philippine Coast Guard's discovery that there is a large area in the Philippines' 200-mile Exclusive Economic Zone in the West Philippine Sea where many corals have been severely damaged.

text: In fact, nakita gid sang mga mananalom sang PCG kon ano kasubo ang nadangtan sang sining mga koral.
english: In fact, the PCG farmers saw how sad these corals were.

text: Indi lang nagkarusdak (ruined), nagkalamatay gid!
english: Not only ruined, but dead!

text: Daku nga halit ini matuod sa aton maritime environment dira sa aton 200 nautical mile EEZ nga gindaug pa naton sa International Tribunal sa kaso nga gin-file naton batok sa China sadtong 2016 sa isyu sang Scarborough Shoal.
english: This is a big damage to our maritime environment in our 200 nautical mile EEZ that we won in the International Tribunal in the case we filed against China in 2016 on the issue of Scarborough Shoal.

text: Diri sa mga koral nga  ini nagapanginaon, nagamuad kag gatener ang mga isda agud padayon makahatag sing pangabuhian sa aton mga mangingisda kag agud mapakaon sang isda ang aton mga pumuluyo.
english: It is in these corals that the fish feed, breed and breed to continue to provide livelihood to our fishermen and to feed our people with fish.

text: Apang tungod patay na ang mga ini wala na dira sing mga isda kag kinahanglan “matamnan” na ini.
english: But since they are dead, there are no fish there and they need to be “planted”.

text: Ang masubo ugaling kay ang pagpatubo sini abtan pa sang ginatos ka tuig.
english: Unfortunately, it will take hundreds of years to grow.

text:
***

Sin-o gid bala ang mapasibangdan naton sa sining pagkalamatay sang mga koral sa sulod sang aton EEZ?
english:
***

Who exactly can we blame for this death of corals within our EEZ?

text: Kag mapanabat gid bala naton ang China sa sining kahalitan sang mga koral sa sulod sang aton EEZ?
english: And can we really hold China accountable for this coral damage within our EEZ?

text: Gaduha-duha si Pedro, labi na gid kay gabarangisi gid angChina sa pagsiling nga wala man kita ebidensya sa ining akusasyon.
english: Pedro is skeptical, especially since China is so insistent on saying that we have no evidence for this accusation.

text: Well, kon sa direct evidence ang pagahambalon, posible wala gid kay wala sang isa sa aton sa Filipinas ang makasiling nga nakita gid sila nga nagahimo sini.
english: Well, when it comes to direct evidence, probably nothing because none of us in the Philippines can say that we have actually seen them doing it.

text: In fact, sang bisan kon sin-o man nga nahibal-an naton.
english: In fact, by anyone that we know of.

text: Posible gani nga magsiling sila nga wala man nagadangat ang ila pagpanagat sa ginaluntaran sang mga koral sa idalom sang dagat.
english: They may even say that their fishing does not reach the location of the underwater coral reefs.

text: Kay nagapanunton man lang sila nga wala nagatungkad sa kaidadalman, ukon nagaladlad lang sila sang ila palutaw nga gamit sa pagpangdakop sang isda dira.
english: For they fish without diving into the depths, or they spread out their nets to catch fish.

text: Ugaling sa ginatos nga nagapondo sa pagpanagat nga mangingisda sang China diri, ang paghulog kag pagganoy sang  ila mga pondo (anchor) bag-o makadulot sa naluntaran sang mga koral nagaguba ini sang mga koral.
english: However, for the hundreds of Chinese fishermen who are fishing here, dropping and pulling their anchors before reaching the coral reefs destroys the corals.

text: Basi ginhiluan pa gani nila ining mga koral agud lubos na magkalamatay kag matampukan para maka-reclaim sang isa pa ka isla sa lawod nga nahimo na sang China sa pila ka kahigayunan.
english: Maybe they even poisoned these corals to kill them completely and pile them up to reclaim another island in the sea that China has done on several occasions.

text: But, of course,indi kita makasiling sini kay wala man kita personal nga pagkahibalo.
english: But, of course, we can't say that because we don't have personal knowledge.

text: Pero indi man lang ang direct evidence ang mabasehan sang isa ka akusasyon agud mapadulot ang kaso.
english: But direct evidence is not the only basis for an accusation to be brought.

text: Pwede man ang indirect proof, ukon proof by contradiction, kon diin malab-ut man ang kamatuoran paagi sa masaligan nga argumento ukon logica (logic) nga indi mabalibaran sang aton human senses.
english: There can also be indirect proof, or proof by contradiction, where the truth can be reached through a reliable argument or logic that cannot be rejected by our human senses.

text:
***

Indi kita abogado, apang may pila man kita ka tuig sa pagtuon sa abogasya bag-o nag-untat.
english:
***

We are not lawyers, but we also had a few years of law school before dropping out.

text: Natun-an man naton kon paano magpadulot sang akusasyon ukon pagsabat sini base sa natun-an naton bilang myembro sang debating team sadto sang University of Iloilo, kag assistant coach (ni Abogado kag Judge Pepito Gellada) sang isa pa ka team sang UI.
english: We also learned how to present an accusation or answer it based on what we learned as a member of the former debating team of the University of Iloilo, and assistant coach (of Lawyer and Judge Pepito Gellada) of another UI team.

text: Sa nahibal-an naton, ang direct evidence galakip sang personal knowledge sang natabo kag paggamit sang forensic evidence katulad sang fingerprint kag DNA test.
english: As we know, direct evidence includes personal knowledge of the incident and the use of forensic evidence such as fingerprints and DNA tests.

text: Samtang ang “proof by contradiction” pwede makita sa argumento nga: (1) Indi pwede nga flat (pahandog) ang kalibutan otherwise mahulog ka sa edge (kanto) sang inang flat nga kalibutan, kag (2) Indi pwede nga wala siya sang kahilabtanan sa krimen kay siya man lang ang kaupod sang biktima sa kwarto sang matabo ini.
english: While the “proof by contradiction” can be seen in the argument that: (1) The world cannot be flat otherwise you will fall on the edge of that flat world, and (2) He cannot have nothing to do with the crime because he was the only one in the victim's room when it happened.

text: In fact, ang ining proof by contradiction ginatun-an gani ini sang mga estudyane sa hayskul sa ila pagtuon sa Mathematical logic sa subject nga Geometry nga sadto ginatudlo naton sa Molo (Iloilo City) National High School.
english: In fact, this proof by contradiction is even studied by high school students in their studies of mathematical logic in the subject of Geometry that we used to teach in Molo (Iloilo City) National High School.

text: Ugaling ang paghulog sang court ruling pwede ang “guilty without reasonable doubt” kag “prepondence of evidence” lang kon indi gid lubos matagaan sing 100% nga pagpamatuod, nga masami ginpamatbat sa mga civil cases for damages, kag indi sa criminal cases nga may dala nga penalidad sang pagka-bilanggo.
english: However, the court ruling can only be "guilty without reasonable doubt" and "prepondence of evidence" if not fully given 100% proof, which is often interpreted in civil cases for damages, and not in criminal cases that carry the penalty of imprisonment.

text:
***

So, ano ayhan nga kaso ang ma-file sang aton gobyerno  sa sining pagkalamatay sang koral sa aton EEZ?
english:
***

So, what case can our government file for this coral death in our EEZ?

text: Pwede ang civil case for damages lang seguro, sa hangop man naton sa panugdaon ni DOJ Sec.
english: The civil case for damages is allowed, in our understanding of the proposal of DOJ Sec.

text: Remulla tungod indi naton mapamatud-an ini sa direct evidence kag paagi lang sa circumstantial evidence kag mabakod nga argumento kag logica (logic)./PN
english: Remulla because we cannot prove it with direct evidence and only through circumstantial evidence and strong argument and logic./PN

english: According to the investigation, the veteran big man also played in several other unsanctioned exhibition games such as the 'Ligang Labas' games in Davao and Laguna besides the one in Cebu.

english: The 36-year-old Belga will pay a fine of 15 days’ worth of his salary.

english: On Thursday, January 23, they will be able to legally register their marriage.

english: Thailand has long had a good reputation for acceptance and inclusivity, but it has also struggled to pass a marriage equality law because of its conservative values.

text: Bangud sini nga mga pagbag-o, hingalitan sang Tourism Authority of Thailand (TAT) ang trend kag magapatigayon na lamang sang trade meetings kag mga negosyo nga ang target amo ang same-sex couples nga nagaplano nga magpakasal.

english: According to Siripakorn Cheawsamoot, tourism deputy governor for Europe, Africa, the Middle East and the Americas, they have many marketing activities for LGBTQ+ people to help the private sector meet the demand along with this trend.

english: The Bureau of Customs (BOC) will prosecute the three importers of the 13 smuggled luxury cars of the Discayas.

text: Antes kay Trump, una nga nagpanumpa ang iya vice president nga si JD Vance sang Ohio.
english: Before Trump, his vice president, JD Vance of Ohio, was sworn in first.

text: Suno sa incoming White House officials, madamo sang pirmahan nga executive orders sa una nga adlaw sang pagbalik sang 78-anyos nga Republican bilang presidente lakip na ang 10 nga nakatutok sa border security and immigration nga amo ang nagapanguna sa iya nga prayoridad.
english: According to incoming White House officials, many executive orders will be signed on the first day of the 78-year-old Republican's return as president including 10 focused on border security and immigration which is his top priority.

text: Magadeklarar man ang presidente sang national emergency sa southern border, magapadala didto sang armado nga tropa, kag i-resume ang polisa nga magapwersa sa asylum seekers nga maghulat sa Mexico sang ila nga US court dates.
english: The president will also declare a national emergency on the southern border, send armed troops there, and resume a policy that will force asylum seekers to wait in Mexico for their US court dates.

text:
Tapuson man ni Trump ang birthright citizenship sa US-born children nga ang ginikanan wala sang legal status — isa ka tikang nga ginlaragway sang legal scholars nga ‘unconstitutional.’

Ang inagurasyon ni Trump nagamarka sang madinalag-on nga comeback sa pulitika matapos sini nalampuwasan ang duha ka impeachment trials, na-convict sa kaso-kriminal, na-indict sa tuyo nga baliskadon ang iya kalutusan sang 2020, kag nalampuwasan man sini nga duha ka assassination attempts.
english:
Trump will also end birthright citizenship to US-born children whose parents do not have legal status — a move legal scholars have described as ‘unconstitutional.’

Trump's inauguration marks a successful political comeback after he survived two impeachment trials, a criminal conviction, an indictment to overturn his 2020 defeat, and two assassination attempts.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, yara man si former Secretary of State Hillary Clinton kag iya bana nga si Bill, apang wala naman nagtambong ang asawa ni Barack nga si Michelle.
english: Meanwhile, former Secretary of State Hillary Clinton and her husband Bill were also present, but Barack's wife Michelle did not attend.

text: Nakapwesto man sa entablado ang pila sa nagapanguna sa pinakamanggaranon nga tawo sa kalibutan nga amo sanday Tesla and SpaceX CEO Elon Musk, Amazon CEO Jeff Bezos kag Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg.
english: Also on stage were some of the world's richest people, including Tesla and SpaceX CEO Elon Musk, Amazon CEO Jeff Bezos and Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg.

text: Sang nadala na sini ang cash, gilayon man ini nga nagpalagyo.

english: According to Trade and Industry Undersecretary Ruth Castelo, this includes limiting the number of traders involved in the supply chain of imported and locally produced bombays.

text: Ginpahayag sang opisyal nga kun mas madamo ang traders nga involved, mas mataas man ang mark-up sang presyo sang bombay kun makalab-ot na sa local markets.
english: The official said that the more traders involved, the higher the mark-up of the price of bombay when it reaches the local markets.

text: Ginpahayag ni Castelo nga may iban pa nga gin-aprubahan si Presidente Marcos apang wala pa sang opisyal nga gin-anunsyo sang Department of Trade and Industry.
english: Castelo said President Marcos has approved others but none have been officially announced by the Department of Trade and Industry.

text: ILOILO – Gintapos na ni Jason Marvin Hernandez ang huring-huring nga bulagay na sila sang iya asawa nga si Moira Dela Torre.
english: ILOILO CITY – Jason Marvin Hernandez has ended rumors that he and his wife Moira Dela Torre are separated.

text: Sa iya social media account, ginpahayag ni Jason nga kasado sila sa gihapon ni Moira, wala sang cheating nga natabo, pareho sa gihapon ang ginasuportahan nga kandidato kag wala sang may natabo nga kinawatay sang kwarta.
english: On his social media account, Jason said that he and Moira are still married, there was no cheating, they still support the same candidate and there was no theft of money.

text: Subong nga semana santa, nangin matunog ang pagbulagay sang duha bangud nga ginapahayag nga ginpanas ni Moira ang pictures nila ni Jason kag indi sila updanay sa trip sa Singapore.
english: This Easter week, the two became loud because Moira allegedly deleted pictures of her and Jason and they were not together on the trip to Singapore.

text: Gindeklarar sang National Grid Corporation of the Philippines (NGCP) ang yellow alert status sa Visayas grid bangud sa indi supisiyente nga power reserves nga posible magresulta sa brownout.
english: The National Grid Corporation of the Philippines (NGCP) has declared yellow alert status in the Visayas grid due to insufficient power reserves that could result in brownouts.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Reagan Alcantara, Lead Specialist sang Public Relations Department sang NGCP, ginpahayag sini nga ang yellow alert status nagakahulugan nga wala nakalabot ang power reserves sang grid sa required minimum level.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Reagan Alcantara, Lead Specialist of the Public Relations Department of NGCP, said the yellow alert status means that the power reserves of the grid have not reached the required minimum level.

text:
Base sa update, nag-umpisa ang yellow alert sang ala-1 sang hapon kag magapadayon tubtob alas-9 sang gab-i.

May epekto man ini sa bug-os nga Visayas grid nga nagaalagad sa mga lugar nga amo ang Samar, Leyte, Cebu, Bohol, Negros kag Panay.
english:
Based on the update, the yellow alert started at 1 pm and will continue until 9 pm.

It also affects the entire Visayas grid serving the areas of Samar, Leyte, Cebu, Bohol, Negros and Panay.

text: Ginpasiguro man sang NGCP nga normal ang kahimtangan sang Luzon kag Mindanao grids sa karon.
english: NGCP also assured that the Luzon and Mindanao grids are in normal condition.

english:

Areas of Batanes are still under typhoon signal number 1; Calayan Island., Dalupiri Island in Babuyan Island; Bangui, Pagudpud, Burgos, Pasuquin, Bacarra, Laoag City in Ilocos Norte.

text: Sa sulod sang 12 ka oras, possible mag-landfall ang bagyo sa Batanes kag magaagi man sa Babuyan Island subong nga adlaw, Oktubre 23.
english: Within 12 hours, the typhoon is likely to landfall in Batanes and will also pass through Babuyan Island today, October 23.

text: Good news matapos ang tatlo ka semana nga sunod-sunod nga oil price hike sang bulan sang Enero!
english: Good news after three consecutive weeks of oil price hikes in January!

text:
Diesel – nabuhinan sang P3.00 sa kada litro

Gasoline – nabuhinan sang P2.10 sa kada litro

Kerosene – nabuhinan sang P2.30 sa kada litro

Lakip sa mga rason nga gintumod sang Department of Energy (DOE) sa pagnubo sa presyo sang produktong petrolyo sa global market amo ang pagsaka sang oil stockpiles sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika amo man ang nagbaskog nga United States jobs data nga amo ang ginalauman nga maga-resulta sang dugang nga interest hike sa United States Federal Reserve System.
english:
Diesel – reduced by P3.00 per liter

Gasoline – reduced by P2.10 per liter

Kerosene – reduced by P2.30 per liter

Among the reasons cited by the Department of Energy (DOE) for the decline in petroleum product prices in the global market are the rise in oil stockpiles in the United States of America as well as the strengthening United States jobs data which is expected to result in an additional interest hike in the United States Federal Reserve System.

english: Meanwhile, the Bureau of Fire Protection also received a pick-up unit, four printers and a laptop to boost its administrative operations.

text: Nag-abot na si United States President-elect Donald Trump sa Washington D.C. apang may tambungan pa nga pila ka mga aktibidad kag selebrasyon antes ang inagurasyon kag ang pormal nga pagbalik sa pwesto.
english: United States President-elect Donald Trump has arrived in Washington D.C. but there will be several activities and celebrations before the inauguration and the formal return to office.

text: Antes ang inagurasyon sa iya, ginalauman nga magakadto man ang Republican sa Arlington National Cemetery kag maga-upod anay sa rally sang iya supporters sa Capital One Arena sa downtown Washington, DC.
english: Before his inauguration, the Republican is also expected to visit Arlington National Cemetery and join a rally of his supporters at the Capital One Arena in downtown Washington, DC.

text: May yara man ini sang kadtuan nga dinner event kag ginalauman nga may iga-deliver nga address.
english: He also has a dinner event to attend and is expected to deliver an address.

text: Nagpaandam si House Speaker Martin Romualdez nga ilisipon na lang ang adlaw sang mga nagamanipula sa presyo sang bombay kag ahos sa merkado.
english: House Speaker Martin Romualdez warned that the days of those who manipulate the price of bombay and garlic in the market are numbered.

text: Wilfrido Mark Enverga nga magpatigayon sang imbestigasyon kag kun may mga makit-an nga ebidensya, dapat nga ipasaka ang nagakaigu nga kaso-kriminal.
english: Wilfrido Mark Enverga to conduct an investigation and if there is evidence found, appropriate criminal cases should be filed.

text: Isa ini ka sahi sang economic sabotage suno pa sa opisyal.
english: This is a form of economic sabotage, the official said.

text: Kun madayon man ini nga calibrated importation suno sa iya, dapat indi sini mabutang sa alang-alang ang ikaayo sang local farmers.
english: If this calibrated importation continues, he said, it should not put the welfare of local farmers at risk.

text: Sa subong abanse na ang Kings, 2-0, sa first-round playoff series batok sa reigning champion nga Warriors matapos nadag-an ang duha ka una nga hampang.
english: The Kings are now ahead, 2-0, in the first-round playoff series against the reigning champion Warriors after winning the first two games.

text: Ginapahayag nga una nga nagbiya si Toni sa produksyon sang pelikula bangud conflict ini sa iya nga schedule.
english: Toni reportedly left the production of the film because it conflicted with her schedule.

text: Ang New York film nga “Asian Persuasion” ang ginapangunahan sang Ilonggo kag multi-Tony Award kag Grammy-winning producer nga si Jhett Tolentino.
english: The New York film “Asian Persuasion” is helmed by Ilonggo and multi-Tony Award and Grammy-winning producer Jhett Tolentino.

text: Lakip sa makaupod ni KC nga Asian celebrities amo ang Filipino-American Hollywood actor nga si Dante Basco.
english: Among KC's Asian celebrities is Filipino-American Hollywood actor Dante Basco.

text: Domingo sang hapon oras diri sa Pilipinas sang nag-notify ang TikTok nga nangin epektibo na ang pag-ban sang Estados Unidos batok sa ila nga application.
english: It was Sunday afternoon here in the Philippines when TikTok notified that the US ban against their application has become effective.

text: Kasunod ina sang pagpabor sang US Supreme Court sa desisyon sang Congress nga dumilian na nga maka-operate sa bilog nga pungsod ang TikTok epektibo Enero 19 kun indi ini mabaligya sa non-Chinese buyer.
english: This follows the US Supreme Court's upholding of Congress' decision to ban TikTok from operating nationwide effective January 19 if it is not sold to a non-Chinese buyer.

text: Kadungan sa pag-ban sa TikTok, nangin offline man kag wala na sa US app stores ang iban pa nga applications sang ByteDance lakip na ang video editing app nga CapCut kag lifestyle social app nga Lemon8.
english: Along with the ban on TikTok, other ByteDance applications including video editing app CapCut and lifestyle social app Lemon8 have also been offline and no longer available in US app stores.

text: Ang mga proyekto nga ginatumod amo ang Esplanade slope protection sa Barangay Mohon sa Arevalo, Barangay Calubihan kag Desamparados sa Jaro kag amo man sa Barangay Bakhaw kag Bolilao sa distrito sang Mandurriao.
english: The projects in question are Esplanade slope protection in Barangay Mohon in Arevalo, Barangay Calubihan and Desamparados in Jaro as well as in Barangay Bakhaw and Bolilao in Mandurriao district.

english: By: 𝑩𝒐𝒎𝒃𝒐 𝑯𝒂𝒏𝒏𝒂 𝑨𝒏𝒅𝒔𝒂

text: Nagaguwa sa medico-legal nga ‘physically fit’ ang duha ka mga kabataan nga una ginaalegar gin-hostage sang ila 31-anyos nga amay sa Barangay Compo, San Enrique, Iloilo.
english: The two children who were first allegedly held hostage by their 31-year-old father in Barangay Compo, San Enrique, Iloilo are physically fit.

text: Gin-athag man sini nga padayon nga nagapaidalom sa counseling ang amay lakip na ang mga kabataan agud mahatagan sang nagakaigo nga intervention.
english: He also explained that the father and the children are continuing to undergo counseling to be given appropriate intervention.

text: Ini agud diskusyunan ang mangin mechanics sang restitution uko pagbalik sang ginapahayag kinawat nga manggad tuhoy sa maanomaliya nga flood control projects.
english: This is to discuss the mechanics of restitution or return of allegedly stolen property regarding anomalous flood control projects.

text: “I expect to have a dialogue… with the presiding justice again on Monday… We’re also trying to lay down the mechanics for institution,” pahayag ni Remulla sa isa ka press conference kahapon, Oct.
english: “I expect to have a dialogue… with the presiding justice again on Monday… We’re also trying to lay down the mechanics for institution,” Remulla said in a press conference yesterday, Oct.

text: Isa ka daog na lang ang kinahanglan sang TNT Tropang Giga antes maagaw ang kampeonato gikan sa Barangay Ginebra sa PBA Governors’ Cup.
english: TNT Tropang Giga needs only one win to clinch the championship from Barangay Ginebra in the PBA Governors' Cup.

text: Abanse na ang TNT sa serye, 3-2, matapos ginlampaso ang Gin Kings sa Game 5 sang finals sa atubang sang masobra 10,000 ka fans sa Smart Araneta Coliseum, 104-95.
english: TNT leads the series, 3-2, after beating the Gin Kings in Game 5 of the finals in front of more than 10,000 fans at the Smart Araneta Coliseum, 104-95.

text: Nakaamot si Calvin Oftana sang 20 points samtang si Mikey Williams naman ang may yara sang 15.
english: Calvin Oftana contributed 20 points while Mikey Williams had 15.

text: Talalupangdon man nga wala nakahampang ang Gin Kings import nga si Justin Brownlee sa second half bangud sa “severe” food poisoning.
english: It’s also worth noting that Gin Kings import Justin Brownlee missed the second half due to “severe” food poisoning.

text: Bangud wala si Brownlee, nagpanguna sa defending champions si Christian Standhardinger nga nakatipon sang 29 points, 13 rebounds kag four assists.
english: With Brownlee out, Christian Standhardinger led the defending champions with 29 points, 13 rebounds and four assists.

text: Balantayan sa Byernes ang Game 6 sa amo man sa gihapon nga venue.
english: Game 6 will be watched on Friday at the same venue.

text: May yara man sang 11.18/kg nga price hike.
english: There was also an 11.18/kg price hike.

text: Suno kay Department of Energy Assistant Director Rodela Romero, nagsaka ang international prices bangud sang pagsaka sang demand sa China apisar sang announcement sang International Monetary Fund nga may yara sang matabo nga global recession.
english: According to Department of Energy Assistant Director Rodela Romero, international prices rose due to increased demand in China despite the announcement of the International Monetary Fund that there will be a global recession.

text: Ang nasambit nga drone ang nagbunggo sa CL-415 firefighting planes nga nagakarga sang masobra 1,500 gallons sang ocean water agud ibasya sa kalayo.
english: The drone collided with CL-415 firefighting planes carrying more than 1,500 gallons of ocean water to be sprayed on the fire.

text: Suno sa Los Angeles Fire Department, sa subong, indi pa makalupad liwat ang eroplano bangud sa naangkon nga damage kag sa masunod nga semana pa ini makaayo kag makalupad liwat.
english: According to the Los Angeles Fire Department, the plane is currently unable to fly again due to the damage sustained and will be able to repair and fly again next week.

text: Nagpaandam man ang otoridad nga sin-o man nga magpalupad sang drone sa restricted airspace nga wala sang pahanugot ang mahimo mangatubang sang legal nga konsekwensya.
english: The authorities also warned that anyone who flies a drone in restricted airspace without permission could face legal consequences.

text: Suno naman kay Bombo Rachel Mackey, international correspondent sa California, sa subong, magluwas sa pagbato sa kalayo, problema man sang otoridad ang kinawatay sa mga balay nga wala sang tawo matapos nag-evacuate ang mga ini.
english: According to Bombo Rachel Mackey, international correspondent in California, besides fighting the fire, the authorities are also facing theft from empty houses after they evacuated.

text: Pahayag ni Mackey, indi magnubo sa 10 ka mga tawo ang ginpangdakop sang kapulisan bangud sa pagpangawat kag iban pa nga sahi sang krimen naangot sa pagpanghingalit sa sitwasyon.
english: Mackey said at least 10 people were arrested by the police for theft and other types of crimes related to the exploitation of the situation.

text: Ginakabig sang Police Regional Office 6 (PRO-6) nga makaalarma ang pagduging sang iligal nga druga sa Western Visayas.
english: The Police Regional Office 6 (PRO-6) considers the increase in illegal drugs in Western Visayas as alarming.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Brigadier General Jack Wanky, regional director sang PRO-6, iya ginpahayag nga isa ka dako nga pagpanghangkat sa bahin sang kapulisan ang liwat na naman nga pagdamo sang iligal nga druga.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Brigadier General Jack Wanky, regional director of PRO-6, said the resurgence of illegal drugs is a major challenge for the police.

text: Dugang sini nga ang BADAC ang may responsibilidad sa pag-monitor sa tagsa ka mga barangay ilabi na sa mga indibidwal nga anay may engagement sa illegal drugs.
english: He added that BADAC has the responsibility to monitor each barangay especially individuals who were previously engaged in illegal drugs.

text: Ginpanugyan man sini nga dapat may holistic approach, kag indi lang responsabilidad sang Iloilo City Government kundi kinahanglan may partisipasyon man ang mga ginikanan, mga barangay kag stakeholders.
english: He also advised that there should be a holistic approach, and not only the responsibility of the Iloilo City Government but also the participation of parents, barangays and stakeholders.

text: Kabahin man sang plano ang pagbutang sang satellite police stations sa mga pampubliko nga lugar para malikawan ang pagdamo sang gang groups.
english: The plan also includes the installation of satellite police stations in public places to prevent the proliferation of gang groups.

text: Suno pa kay Fantilaga-Gorzal, “Kung indi ini pagtutukan, mahimo nga criminal ang mga kabataan.
english: According to Fantilaga-Gorzal, “If this is not addressed, children can become criminals.

text: Indi na kita maghulat nga may mapatay kag may mapilasan.”
english: Let’s not wait for someone to die and someone to get hurt.”

text: Indi lang tungod sa reklamo sang mga trabahador sa ila kita kundi pati na sa oras kag kahimtangan nila sa trabaho.
english: Not only because of workers' complaints about their income but also about their working hours and conditions.

text: Nangin mainit ang indi pag-intiendihanay sang mga kapitalista kag mga trabahador sadto nga ginagamhan ang gobyerno sang mga kapitalista kag mga poderoso.
english: The conflict between capitalists and workers became heated at the time when the government was dominated by the capitalists and the powerful.

text: Too late ugaling ma-realize ini sang pila ka gobyerno nga ginpabay-an ang sobra nga kahilwayan sa ekonomiya sa kamot sang mga kapitalista.
english: Too late however, some governments will realize that they have left too much economic freedom in the hands of the capitalists.

text: Bag-o ini ugaling sang mapatuman na ang mga regulasyon sa maayo nga relasyon sang mga kapitalista kag mga trabahador.
english: This was new, however, when regulations on good relations between capitalists and workers were implemented.

text: Kag nagtuhaw ang pagbinahin-bahin sang panghuna-huna kon ano  gid ang maayo nila nga relasyon kag kon ano gid ang pinakamaayo para sa kabug-usan sang mga pumuluyo.
english: And there was a division of opinion about what their relationship was and what was best for the people as a whole.

text: Tungod sa malawak nga Kahilwayan nga ginhatag sa mga pumuluyo sa ila kabuhian nakilala sang ulihi ang Kapitalista nga mga pungsod nga Demokrasyahon, kon diin ang matuod nga gamhanan amo ang mga pumuluyo kag indi ang gobyerno.
english: Because of the wide freedom given to the people in their lives, Capitalist countries were later known as Democracies, where the true power is the people and not the government.

text: Labi na gid ang mga lantip sa siyensya sang Economics kag Business kag pag-ulhot sang mga agriculturists sa panguma kag pangisda nga nagapasanyog sang aton ikaon sa lamesa.
english: Especially those who are skilled in the sciences of Economics and Business and the emergence of agriculturists in agriculture and fisheries who improve our food on the table.

text: Na-realize man nila nga kinahanglan man nila gali ang pribado nga kapital kon ngaa, sa karon, napasugtan na nila ang pagsulod sang madamo nga negosyo pribado sa ila mga pungsod.
english: They also realized that they also needed private capital, which is why, today, they have allowed many private businesses to enter their countries.

text: On the other hand, madamo nga welfare programs sa mga pungsod nga Sosyalista ang gin-adoptar man sang mga kapitalista nga mga pungsod.
english: On the other hand, many welfare programs in Socialist countries have also been adopted by capitalist countries.

text: In fact, may mga multi-millionaire na sa China kag Russia kag mga communal living, katulad sang mga kooperatiba, sa Western Countries kag ila mga kaalyado nga posible na-kopya man sa mga Sosyalista nga mga pungsod.
english: In fact, there are already multi-millionaires in China and Russia and communal living, such as cooperatives, in Western Countries and their allies that may have been copied in Socialist countries.

text: “We do not live by bread alone…,” siling gani sang Balaan nga Kasulatan./PN
english: “We do not live by bread alone…,” says the Holy Scriptures./PN

text: Naghatag sang kabug-usan nga P10 million ang beauty queen kag negosysante nga si Celeste Cortesi para sa mga biktima sang mga nagluntad nga linog sa Cebu kag Davao Oriental.
english: Beauty queen and businesswoman Celeste Cortesi donated a total of P10 million to the victims of the earthquakes in Cebu and Davao Oriental.

text: Natalana nga mangin flag‑bearers sang Pilipinas sa opening ceremony sanday Bryan Bagunas kag Alex Eala.
english: Bryan Bagunas and Alex Eala are scheduled to be the flag‐bearers of the Philippines at the opening ceremony.

text: Gin-require sila nga magtinir sa gym sa bilog nga hampang bisan sa ila nga short break.
english: They were required to stay in the gym throughout the game even during their short break.

text: Ang players lunsay katapo sang Men Opposing Sex Trafficking (MOST)nga isa ka Atlanta-based nonprofit organization.
english: The players are all members of Men Opposing Sex Trafficking (MOST)which is an Atlanta-based nonprofit organization.

text: Sila ang nagsugod sang lima ka adlaw nga marathon agud nga mapakilala ang ila kawsa kag agud nga makatipon sang pondo.
english: They initiated the five-day marathon to raise awareness of their cause and to raise funds.

text: Natukod ang MOST sang 2022 agud mag-edukar ang iban nga mga lalaki nga magbulig nga matapna ang sex trafficking.
english: MOST was founded in 2022 to educate other men to help prevent sex trafficking.

text: Ini nga nonprofit nagalakip na sang data analysts kag interdiction team sang former military kag law enforcement professionals nga nagabulig sa sting operations and prevention sa bilog nga pungsod.
english: This nonprofit already includes data analysts and an interdiction team of former military and law enforcement professionals who help with sting operations and prevention across the country.

text: Sang ginhimo nila ang word record, gin-livestream man sila kag naghatag naman sang donasyon ang ila nga supporters.
english: When they made the word record, they were also livestreamed and their supporters donated.

text: Sa kabug-usan, nakatipon matuod ang grupo sang masobra $300,000 ukon masobra sa P17.2-million para sa ila nga misyon.#
english: In total, the group raised more than $300,000 or more than P17.2-million for their mission.

text: Arestado ang tatlo ka mga indibidwal lakip ang anay pulis kag incumbent barangay kagawad sa ginpatigayon nga drug buy bust sa Brgy.
english: Three individuals including a former policeman and incumbent barangay kagawad were arrested in a drug buy bust in Brgy.

text: Licu-an, Dingle, Iloilo, Pebrero 15.
english: Licu-an, Dingle, Iloilo, February 15.

text: Nagdangat sa 310 gramos ang kabug-usan nga nakumpiska nga ginapasuni nga shabu nga may standard drug price nga P2,108,000.
english: The total amount of suspected shabu seized was 310 grams with a standard drug price of P2,108,000.

text: Nahunong ang mga arestado sa Dingle Municipal Police Station kag natalana nga mag-atubang sa panumbungon nga paglapas sa Republic Act 9165 ukon Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002.#
english: The suspects are detained at the Dingle Municipal Police Station and are scheduled to face charges of violation of Republic Act 9165 or Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002.#

text: Gindeklarar ni Mayor Raisa Treñas sang Iloilo City ang Temporary Cease and Desist Order batok sa tanan nga ongoing waterway projects sang Iloilo City District Engineering Office sang Department of Public Works and Highways kag sang Iloilo City District Engineering Office sa distrito sang Jaro.
english: Mayor Raisa Treñas of Iloilo City declared a Temporary Cease and Desist Order against all ongoing waterway projects of the Iloilo City District Engineering Office of the Department of Public Works and Highways and the Iloilo City District Engineering Office in Jaro district.

text: Dugang pa, ginpahayag man ni Mayor Treñas nga nagkadto sa iya opisina si Mayor Sofronio Fusin sang Oton agud magpangayo sang bulig, matapos nakaeksperyensya sang pagbaha ang anum ka barangay sa ila banwa, nga wala pa natabu bisan sang bagyo Frank sang 2008.
english: In addition, Mayor Treñas said that Mayor Sofronio Fusin of Oton came to his office to ask for help, after six barangays in their town experienced flooding, which has not happened even during Typhoon Frank in 2008.

text: ILOILO CITY- Nakahibalo ka bala nga yara lang sa palibot sang imo balay ang tanom nga makabulig agud magbaskog pa ang imo sex drive?
english: ILOILO CITY- Did you know that there are plants around your house that can help boost your sex drive?

text: Inio suno naman kay Jerlyn Jones, M.S., M.P.A., R.D.N., registered dietitian, certified LEAP therapist kag owner sang The Lifestyle Dietitian.
english: Inio, according to Jerlyn Jones, M.S., M.P.A., R.D.N., registered dietitian, certified LEAP therapist and owner of The Lifestyle Dietitian.

text: Handa si Vice President Sara Duterte nga sabton ang mga reklamo sang impeachment batok sa iya sa isa ka “proper forum,” suno sa iya legal team.
english: Vice President Sara Duterte is ready to answer the impeachment complaints against her in a “proper forum,” according to her legal team.

text: Ini kasunod sa iya wala pagtambong sa hearing sang House Committee on Justice nahanungod sa impeachment nga natabo subong nga adlaw, Marso 25.
english: This follows his absence from the House Committee on Justice hearing on impeachment that took place today, March 25.

text: Ginklaro man sang abogado sini nga wala ginatalikdan ni Duterte ang iya mga katungdanan nga magpahayag sang dapat sini panindugan, pagkontra, ukon paggamit sini sang iya constitutional rights.
english: His lawyer also clarified that Duterte is not abandoning his duties to express his position, oppose, or exercise his constitutional rights.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Atty. Joenar Pueblo, isa ka kilala nga Bombo Abogado, ginpahayag sini nga magahampang sang dako nga papel ang political dynamics ukon ang pagbag-o, interaksyon, kag pag-ukoy sang poder, impluwensya, kag interes sa sulod sang sistema sang politika sa nasambit nga plano.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Atty. Joenar Pueblo, a well-known Bombo lawyer, said political dynamics or the change, interaction, and coexistence of power, influence, and interests within the political system will play a major role in the plan.

text: Dugang pa ni Pueblo, madamo nga mga aktibidad sa bicam deliberations ang kabudlay ipakita sa publiko bangud sa sensibilidad sang ila mga desisyon kag transaksyon.
english: Pueblo added that many activities in bicam deliberations are difficult to show to the public due to the sensitivity of their decisions and transactions.

text: Ginalakipan man ini sang pag-file sang joint resolution sang anum ka House minority lawmakers nga nagapanawagan sang mas bukas nga proseso sa pagsaysay sang budget.Padayon nga ginabantayan ang tikang sang Kamara kun matuman gid bala ang ila ginpasalig sa publiko.
english: This also includes the filing of a joint resolution by six House minority lawmakers calling for a more open process in the budget.

text: Sooc, Arevalo, lunsay mga job hire sang Iloilo City Hall.
english: Sooc, Arevalo, all job hires of Iloilo City Hall.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Joy Maravilla, upod sang duha ka mga naaksidente, iya ginpahayag nga pabalik na kontani ang duha sa ila opisina sang hinali nga nabunggo-an sila sang nagasunod nga truck.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Joy Maravilla, one of the two victims, said the two were returning to their office when they were suddenly hit by a following truck.

text: Suno kay Maravilla, napilpilan sang motorsiklo si Sitchon matapos nga natumba ini, samtang gilayon na man nga nakaguwa si Rebano.
english: According to Maravilla, Sitchon was hit by the motorcycle after he fell, while Rebano immediately got out.

text: Indi lang kalayo ang kasumpong subong sang mga tawo sa Los Angeles County sa California, USA kundi ang posibilidad sa pagkatiphag sang duta.
english: The people of Los Angeles County in California, USA, are facing not only fire but also the possibility of landslides.

text: Halimbawa diri amo ang isa ka balay sa Castellammare Drive nga nakaluwas matuod sa Pacific Palisades wildfire, apang naguba man gihapon kag napihak sa duha matapos nagluntad ang landslide.
english: An example of this is a house on Castellammare Drive that did survive the Pacific Palisades wildfire, but was still destroyed and split in two after a landslide.

text: Suno sa Los Angeles Department of Water and Power, may isa ka balay sa naibabaw nga parte sang area nga una na naguba bangud sa wildfire, kag bangud natiphag ang duta, nag-collapse ini kag natumbahan ang balay nga wala pa kuntani na-damage sa sunog.
english: According to the Los Angeles Department of Water and Power, there was a house in the upper part of the area that was previously destroyed by the wildfire, and because the ground collapsed, it collapsed and fell on the house that was not damaged by the fire.

text: Patas na sa 2-2 ang serye sa Philippine Basketball Association Governor’s Cup finals matapos ginlutos sang TNT ang Barangay Ginebra, 116-104, sa Game 4 sa Araneta Coliseum.
english: The series in the Philippine Basketball Association Governor's Cup finals is tied at 2-2 after TNT defeated Barangay Ginebra, 116-104, in Game 4 at Araneta Coliseum.

text: Sa kinaandan, ginpangunahan sang newly-crowned Best Import nga si Rondae Hollis-Jefferson ang Tropang GIGA paagi sa iya impresibo nga 36 points, 10 rebounds, five assists kag steals.
english: Typically, newly-crowned Best Import Rondae Hollis-Jefferson led Tropang GIGA with an impressive 36 points, 10 rebounds, five assists and steals.

text: Apang sa sini nga Game 4, daku ang nangin amot sang iya teammates nga naka-produce sang kabug-usan nga 21 ka tres nga amo ang pinakadamo nga na-rekord sa PBA Finals series.
english: But in this Game 4, his teammates made a big contribution producing a total of 21 threes which is the most recorded in the PBA Finals series.

text: Sanday Mikey Williams, Kib Montalbo, Calvin Oftana kag Jayson Castro ang nagbulos-bulos sa three-point area agud dalayon nga mapatumba ang defending champions nga Ginebra.
english: Mikey Williams, Kib Montalbo, Calvin Oftana and Jayson Castro took turns in the three-point area to consistently knock down defending champions Ginebra.

text: Si Castro ang may yara sang 17 points, samtang may tag-16 naman sanday Williams, Montalbo kag Oftana.
english: Castro had 17 points, while Williams, Montalbo and Oftana had 16 each.

text: Natalana ang Game 5 sa Myerkules sa amo man gihapon nga venue.
english: Game 5 is scheduled for Wednesday at the same venue.

text: Indi na man makapati ang pamilya sang suspek nga nagtiro-patay sa Barangay Tanod sa Brgy.
english: The family of the suspect who shot dead the Barangay Tanod in Brgy.

text: Ang suspek amo si Regie Gaborno, 41-anyos, driver; samtamg ang biktima amo si Carmelino Minor, 51-anyos, kasado kag lunsay residente sang nasambit nga barangay.
english: The suspects were identified as Regie Gaborno, 41, driver; while the victim was identified as Carmelino Minor, 51, married and both residents of the said barangay.

text: Suno kay Gaborno, wala man sang records sa barangay ang iya anak kag nakaagi man serbe bilang tanod.
english: According to Gaborno, his son has no records in the barangay and has served as a tanod.

text: Gintuad man sini nga antes ang insidente, gin-agda pa siya sang biktima nga si Minor nga mangape kasunod sang pagpadulong sini sa ila balay.
english: He also admitted that before the incident, the victim, Minor, invited him for coffee after he came to their house.

text: Nahibaluan nga magkasilingan lang man ang suspek kag ang biktima kag anay man nangin magkaupod sa pagserbisyo bilang barangay tanod.
english: It was learned that the suspect and the victim were neighbors and had previously served together as barangay tanods.

text: Masobra piso ang isaka sa presyo sang produktong petrolyo sa masunod nga semana.
english: The price of petroleum products will rise by more than a peso next week.

text: Ang gasolina naman posible magsaka sang P1.30 tubtub P1.50 sa kada litro.
english: Gasoline is likely to rise by P1.30 to P1.50 per litre.

text: Magadugang sa pwersa sang TNT ang pagbalik sang beterano nga si Kelly Williams kadungan sang Game 3 sa tunga sang Tropang Giga kag Barangay Ginebra subong nga adlaw sa Philippine Basketball Association (PBA) Governors’ Cup Finals.
english: TNT will be strengthened by the return of veteran Kelly Williams during Game 3 between Tropang Giga and Barangay Ginebra today in the Philippine Basketball Association (PBA) Governors' Cup Finals.

text: Ini ang una nga pagsabak sang 41-anyos nga basketball star para sa TNT matapos nga nakaangkon ini sang injury sang nagligad nga bulan kasunod sang quarterfinal game sang team batok sa Phoenix.
english: This is the 41-year-old basketball star’s first appearance for TNT after suffering an injury last month following the team’s quarterfinal game against Phoenix.

text: Maayo man ang timing sang pagbalik ni Williams bangud injured subong ang isa ka player sang TNT nga si Justin Chua kag indi na makahampang tubtub nga matapos ang best-of-seven series.
english: The timing of Williams' return is also good because TNT player Justin Chua is currently injured and will not play until the end of the best-of-seven series.

text: Nahibaluan nga patas na subong sa 1-1 ang serye matapos nagdaog ang defending champions nga Ginebra sa Game 1 samtang nagbawi naman sa Game 2 ang Tropang Giga.

text: Naga-guwa sa report sang Department of Agriculture (DA) nga mas ginapili sang consumers nga baklon ang imported nga mga ahos bangud mas barato pa ini ipaanggid sa local supply.
english: According to a report by the Department of Agriculture (DA), consumers prefer to buy imported garlic because it is cheaper compared to local supply.

text: Sandig sa pinakaulihi nga market monitoring, ginpahayag sang ahensya nga ang imported garlic ang ginabaligya sa P80 kada kilo nga indi hamak nga mas manubo sa local garlic nga yara sa P300 per kilo ang presyo.
english: Based on the latest market monitoring, the agency said that imported garlic is sold at P80 per kilo which is not much lower than local garlic which is priced at P300 per kilo.

text: Sa amo man nga report, ginpaathag sang agriculture department nga nagnubo ang local stock bangud halos naubos na ang suplay nga para sang nagligad nga tuig bangud sang serye sang holidays sang Disyembre.
english: In the same report, the agriculture department explained that the local stock decreased because the supply for last year was almost exhausted due to the series of holidays in December.

text: Ang ahos nga ginabaligya sa Enero 2023 ang nakuha pa sang katapusan nga harvest sang 2022 nga natabo sa bulan sang Nobyembre.
english: The garlic sold in January 2023 was still harvested by the last harvest of 2022 which took place in the month of November.

text: Sa Ilocos naman kuhaon ang una nga harvest sa 2023 sa bulan pa sang Pebrero kun sa diin ang projected volume ang yara sa 21 metric tons.
english: In Ilocos, the first harvest of 2023 will be taken in February with a projected volume of 21 metric tons.

text: Lauman nga may 3,947 MT nga mangin available para sa consumers sa Abril nga magahalin naman sa 22 ka garlic-producing towns sa Ilocos Region.
english: It is expected that 3,947 MT will be available for consumers in April from 22 garlic-producing towns in the Ilocos Region.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Aguinaldo Bulanon, 41-anyos, iya ginpahayag nga isa ini ka dako nga bulig bangud nga makabyahe na ang ginhatag nga P500 fuel subsidy sa duha ka adlaw.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Aguinaldo Bulanon, 41, said this is a big help because the P500 fuel subsidy will allow them to travel in two days.

text: Dugang pa niya, antes pa ang fuel crisis, makadala pa sila pauli sang masobra P800 nga ila kinitaan sa isa ka adlaw, apang subong yara nalang sa P400 ang madala nila sa ila tagsa ka pamilya.

text: ILOILO CITY-Plano sang Department of Agriculture (DA) nga maglunsar sang pinakauna sini nga border control facilities para sa imported animal kag plant products sa una nga bahin sang 2025, agud malikawan ang pagsulod sang balatian kaangay sang Q fever.

text: Suno kay Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr.,ang Cold Examination Facility for Agriculture (CEFA) ang indi lang makabulig likaw sa ano man nga food contamination outbreaks apang makapahagan-hagan man sang smuggling activities nga makahalit sa palangabuhian sang local farmers.

text: Ang una nga lima ka Cold Examination Facility for Agriculture ang magasugod man sang sanitary kag phytosanitary inspection sang animal, fish, plant kag iban nga agricultural outputs.
english: The first five Cold Examination Facilities for Agriculture will also begin sanitary and phytosanitary inspection of animal, fish, plant and other agricultural outputs.

text: Pahayag ni Tiu Laurel,sa subong padayon ang pagpatukod sang private contractors sang Cold Examination Facility for Agriculture sa Angat, Bulacan kag ginaproseso man ang equipment procurement agud malab-ot ang operational timeline.

text: Ang iban nga pasilidad ang ipatukod sa Septyembre 2025 sa Manila, Subic, Davao kag General Santos City.

Sa mga balantayan nga mga isyu sa pagpatuman sang limpyo nga B&SK elections, mas balantayan gid seguro ang baklanay sang boto (vote-buying) samtang ginapaseguro man ang kalinong sang eleksyon.

***

Among the issues to be watched in the implementation of clean B&SK elections, vote-buying is probably the most watched while ensuring the peace of the election.

text: Ang kandidato nga makita nga nagatipon sang mga tawo sa panahon sang Election Period masiling man nga naga-vote-buying.
