text: Obviously, kasal-anan kon ang rason mo sa pagboto sa kandidato tungod lang sa ginhatag niya nga kwarta, kay ang matarong  nga rason amo ang pilion gid ang bagay botohon.
english: Obviously, it's a sin if your reason for voting for a candidate is just because he gave you money, because the right reason is to choose the right thing to vote for.

text: In other words, kon kasal-anan man ang magbaton kwarta halin sa kandidato, pwede man ini ma-justify nga wala sing bug-at sa konsyensya.
english: In other words, if it is a sin to accept money from a candidate, it can be justified without burden of conscience.

english: The mayor also said that the investigation should be deepened to identify individuals who may be involved in illegal activities.

text: Nagapati man ini nga ang shipment sang iligal nga druga ang nagapakita sang dako nga drug syndicates nga mahimo naga-operate sa syudad.
english: He also believes that the shipment of illegal drugs indicates large drug syndicates that may be operating in the city.

text: Matandaan nga wala nadayon ang ginalauman kuntani nga ‘impeachment trial’ kontra sa bise president sang ma-archive ang articles of impeachment.
english: It can be recalled that the expected impeachment trial against the vice president was canceled when the articles of impeachment were archived.

text: Bangud sini, nanindugan ang amo nga grupo nga indi dapat pagbay-an ang isyu kag alegasyon nga ginapangatubang ni Duterte.
english: The group insisted that the issue and allegations facing Duterte should not be ignored.

text: Kadungan sang pagpauli ni Rabiya sa Iloilo, nagbisita ini sa iya alma matter nga Saint Candida School-Hijas de Jesus, Incorporated sa Barangay Bayuyan, Estancia, Iloilo.
english: Along with Rabiya's return to Iloilo, she visited her alma matter, Saint Candida School-Hijas de Jesus, Incorporated in Barangay Bayuyan, Estancia, Iloilo.

text: Ini ang una nga bes nga maga-host ang Cambodia sang SEA Games.
english: This is the first time Cambodia will host the SEA Games.

text: Suno kay Tolentino, ginahatagan sang balor sang Pilipinas ang selebrasyon nga ini indi lamang para sa sports kundi para sa peace and camaraderie sa rehiyon.
english: According to Tolentino, the Philippines values ​​this celebration not only for sports but also for peace and camaraderie in the region.

text: Sa amo nga torch relay, ang nagdala sang torch amo ang mga atleta sa cycling, taekwondo, football, kickboxing kag boxing nga upod man sa pila ka opisyal sang sports associations sa Pilipinas.
english: In the torch relay, the torch bearers were athletes in cycling, taekwondo, football, kickboxing and boxing who were also accompanied by several officials of sports associations in the Philippines.

text: Patigayunon ang 32nd SEA Games sa Cambodia sa Mayo 5-17.
english: The 32nd SEA Games will be held in Cambodia on May 5-17.

text: Magluwas sa mga napatay, gin-report man ni Sheriff Robert Luna sang Los Angeles County nga may 16 man nga missing sa area kun sa diin nagakatabo ang duha sa pinakadako nga sunog.
english: In addition to the dead, Sheriff Robert Luna of Los Angeles County also reported that there were 16 missing in the area where two of the largest fires occurred.

text: Lakip diri ang 1,354 fire engines, 84 aircraft kag masobra 14,000 personnel lakip na ang ginpadala sang Mexico agud magbulig man sa Estados Unidos.
english: This includes 1,354 fire engines, 84 aircraft and more than 14,000 personnel including those sent by Mexico to assist the United States.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Regiona Dativo, Head sang San Enrique Municipal Social Welfare and Development Office, iya ginpahayag nga nagapaidalom na sa counseling ang amay sang mga kabataan agud mahatagan sang nagakaigo nga intervention.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Regiona Dativo, Head of the San Enrique Municipal Social Welfare and Development Office, said the father of the children is already undergoing counseling to be given appropriate intervention.

text: Gilayon man nga nag-abiso ang MSWDO sa amay nga ipaidalom sila sa counselling.
english: The MSWDO immediately advised the father to undergo counseling.

english: Before becoming a student at the University of Sto.

text: Gina-engganyo ni Senador JV Ejercito ang gobyerno nga gamiton ang kabahin sang P250 billion nga pondo para sa mga flood control projects sa sa pagpatuman sang dalagkuan nga mga imprastraktura kontra sa pagbaham particular sa Central Luzon, samtang ginahulat ang mga reporma sa Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH).
english: Senator JV Ejercito urged the government to use part of the P250 billion fund for flood control projects to implement major anti-flood infrastructure particularly in Central Luzon, while awaiting reforms in the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH).

text: Samtang, ginkumpirma ni Public Works Secretary Vince Dizon nga sa subong magapatigayon ang Detailed Engineering Design (DED) para sa Central Luzon Floodway Project, nga ginpondohan sang Asian Development Bank (ADB).
english: Meanwhile, Public Works Secretary Vince Dizon confirmed that the Detailed Engineering Design (DED) for the Central Luzon Floodway Project, funded by the Asian Development Bank (ADB), will now be conducted.

text: Gintulod liwat ni United States President Joe Biden nga magpatigayon na sang gilayon nga ceasefire sa gyera sang Israel kag Hamas sa Gaza.
english: US President Joe Biden has again pushed for an immediate ceasefire in the war between Israel and Hamas in Gaza.

text: Suno sa White House, ginmuno ini ni Biden kadungan sang ila pag-istoryahanay ni Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu paagi sa telepono.
english: According to the White House, Biden made the remarks during a telephone conversation with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag sang American national security adviser nga si Jake Sullivan nga tuman na gid kalapit ang duha ka mga partido nga makalab-ot sa kasugtanan apang may mga dapat pa nga hitsuhon.
english: Earlier, American national security adviser Jake Sullivan said the two parties were very close to reaching an agreement but there were still things to be done.

text: May tyansa pa suno sa iya nga may agreement nga malab-ot antes ang pagbiya ni President Biden sa pwesto sa Enero 20, apang sa subong may mga balibad pa nga ginahimo ang Hamas.
english: He said there is still a chance that an agreement will be reached before President Biden leaves office on January 20, but Hamas is still making excuses.

text: Oktubre 2023 pa sang nag-umpisa ini nga giyera.
english: It was October 2023 when this war started.

text: Ang mga kabataan ang naga-edad sang walo kag 10 ka tuig kag lunsay lalaki.
english: The children are aged eight and 10 years and both are boys.

text: Ginpahayag ni Senate President Pro Tempore Jinggoy Estrada nga kadam-an sa mga senador nga kabahin sang supermajority ang magatuman sa desisyon sang Korte Suprema nga naga-deklarar nga unconstitutional ang articles of impeachment batuk kay Bise Presidente Sara Duterte.
english: Senate President Pro Tempore Jinggoy Estrada said most of the senators who are part of the supermajority will comply with the Supreme Court's decision declaring the articles of impeachment against Vice President Sara Duterte unconstitutional.

text: Ginpanindugan man ni Estrada nga indi siya magapirma sa draft resolution nga ginapalibot ni Senador Kiko Pangilinan nga naga-apelar nga repasuhon liwat sang Korte Suprema ang iya desisyon may kaangtanan sa impeachment articles.
english: Estrada also insisted that he will not sign the draft resolution circulated by Senator Kiko Pangilinan appealing for the Supreme Court to review its decision regarding the impeachment articles.

text: Apat na ka senador ang nabalita nga nagpirma sa resolusyon: sanday Senators Risa Hontiveros, Bam Aquino, Tito Sotto, kag mismo si Senador Pangilinan.
english: Four senators are reported to have signed the resolution: Senators Risa Hontiveros, Bam Aquino, Tito Sotto, and Senator Pangilinan himself.

text: Suno kay Estrada, bisan pa maayo ang pagpresentar sang mga nagapabor sa resolusyon, ang desisyon sang Korte Suprema ang ila tumanon, luwas na lang kon mabaliskad ini paagi sa motion for reconsideration halin sa Kamara.
english: Estrada said that even if those in favor of the resolution present well, they will abide by the Supreme Court's decision, unless it is overturned by a motion for reconsideration from the House.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Lieutenant Christy Val Dalde, hepe sang San Enrique Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga nagpadala ang bana sang video sa iya misis nga OFW sa diin makit-an nga ginagapos kag ginasakit sini ang iya duha ka mga kabataan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Lieutenant Christy Val Dalde, chief of the San Enrique Municipal Police Station, said the husband sent a video to his OFW wife where he was seen tying and torturing his two children.

text: Suno kay Dalde, ang nagapanguna nga rason sa pagkaakig sang bana amo ang nabaton sini nga video sang iya misis nga nagahimo sang isa ka sexual activity samtang yara sa luwas sang pungsod.
english: According to Dalde, the main reason for the husband's anger was that he received a video of his wife engaging in a sexual activity while abroad.

text: Ginkumpirma man sang hepe nga duha ka beses na nga natabo ang ginapahayag pagsakit sang amay sa duha ka mga kabataan.
english: The chief also confirmed that the father allegedly abused the two children twice.

text: Apat ka halintang ang gintaklad sang Filipinas nga yara anay sa ika-53 sa female ranking sa bug-os nga kalibutan.
english: The Philippines has climbed four steps from 53rd in the world female ranking.

text: Suno naman sa Australian coach sang team nga si Alen Stajcic, pamatuod ini nga padulong sa husto nga direksyon ang team magluwas pa nga magahampang sila sa World Cup subong nga tuig nga labing-una man sa maragtas sang Pilipinas sa patag sang football.
english: According to Australian coach of the team, Alen Stajcic, this is proof that the team is heading in the right direction besides that they will play in the World Cup this year which is also the first in the history of the Philippines in the field of football.

text: Sang damlag lang, nakadangat ang Filipinas sa Pinatar Cup sa Espanya kun sa diin ila naatubang ang Iceland nga ika-16 sa ranking, Scotland nga ika-25, kag Wales nga ika-32.
english: Recently, the Philippines qualified for the Pinatar Cup in Spain where they faced Iceland ranked 16th, Scotland ranked 25th, and Wales ranked 32nd.

text: Apisar nalutos ang team, nangin maayo ini nga exposure antes ang iban nga ginalauman nga international games.
english: Although the team lost, it was a good exposure before other highly anticipated international games.

text: Balantayan sa masunod nga bulan ang pagpasakop sang Filipinas sa Olympic qualifying tournament.
english: The Philippines' participation in the Olympic qualifying tournament will be watched next month.

text: Ginpamatukan sang grupo sang mga sugar producers ang mandu ni Presidente Ferdinand ‘Bongbong’ Marcos Jr.
english: The group of sugar producers opposed President Ferdinand 'Bongbong' Marcos Jr.'s order.

text: sa Department of Agriculture nga padasigon ang importasyon sang 64,050 metric tons sang refined sugar.
english: to the Department of Agriculture to expedite the importation of 64,050 metric tons of refined sugar.

text: Base sa memorandum order nga ginpirmahan ni Agriculture Senior Undersecretary Domingo Panganiban sang Disyembre 20, ginpahayag nga nagakahangawa si Marcos (nga amo subong ang head sang ahensya) mataas nga inflation rate sa sugar.
english: According to a memorandum order signed by Agriculture Senior Undersecretary Domingo Panganiban on December 20, Marcos (who is now the head of the agency) is concerned about the high inflation rate in sugar.

text: Suno sa grupo sang sugar producers, kun yara gani sa peak sang harvest, bastante ang suplay sang raw kag refined sugar kag wala sang nakit-an nga pagkinahanglan sang importasyon.
english: According to the group of sugar producers, even at the peak of harvest, the supply of raw and refined sugar is sufficient and there is no demand for imports.

text: Mas makapalain sa local sugar farmers suno sa grupo kun iduso gid sang gobyerno ang sugar importation.
english: The group said it would be more difficult for local sugar farmers if the government pushed for sugar importation.

text: Apang ginpahayag man niya nga magkaisa gihapon sila bilang mga kasangga, upod ang pila ka mga kongresista sa Kamara.
english: But he also said they are still united as supporters, along with some congressmen in the House.

text: Bilang isa ka miyembro sang minority bloc, ginpahayag ni Hontiveros nga prayoridad niya ang pagpabakod sang oposisyon sa guwa sang Senado.
english: As a member of the minority bloc, Hontiveros said his priority is to strengthen the opposition outside the Senate.

text: Una na niya ginpahayag nga proud siya nga magapabilin bilang miyembro sang minority bloc sa idalum sang liderato ni Senate Minority Leader Vicente Sotto.
english: He earlier said he is proud to remain a member of the minority bloc under the leadership of Senate Minority Leader Vicente Sotto.

text: “At peace” man siya nga liwat nga mangin kabahin sang minorya, subong nga magaserbi siya bilang Deputy Minority Leader sa ika-20 nga Kongreso, ka-upod si Senador Juan Miguel Zubiri.
english: He is also “at peace” to be part of the minority again, now that he will serve as Deputy Minority Leader in the 20th Congress, along with Senator Juan Miguel Zubiri.

english: The husband is alias Jan, 31.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay alyas JP, abyan sang amay, iya ginpahayag nga ang mga kabataan mismo ang naghimo-himo sang drama nga gin-hostage sila sang ila amay.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, JP, a friend of the father, said the children themselves made up the drama that their father took them hostage.

text: Apang gin-athag ni alyas JP nga wala siya makakita sang nasambit nga video.
english: However, JP clarified that he did not see the video.

text: Ginpahayag sini nga mangin si San Enrique Mayor Trixie Fernandez ang nagpadulong man sa lugar agud masigurado ang safety sang mga kabataan.
english: He said San Enrique Mayor Trixie Fernandez also went to the scene to ensure the safety of the children.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, ang piso nag-depresyar halin sa ₱55.70 kontra dolyar sang umpisa sang Hunyo, pakadto sa ₱58.32 sa katapusan nga adlaw sang trading sa Hulyo.
english: On the other hand, the peso depreciated from ₱55.70 against the dollar at the beginning of June, to ₱58.32 on the last trading day in July.

text: Ang benchmark interest rate sang BSP yara na subong sa 5.25%, kag may posibilidad nga magapadayon pa ini nga panubo sa masunod nga policy-setting meeting sa Agosto, suno sa mga economic analysts.
english: The BSP’s benchmark interest rate is now at 5.25%, and there is a possibility that it will continue lower at the next policy-setting meeting in August, according to economic analysts.

text: Ginhimo ni Atty. Conti nga nagserbe man nga counsel para sa mga biktima sang war on drugs sang anay presidente, matapos ipagguwa ang isa ka dokumento angot sa pag-appoint sang ICC Pre-Trial Chamber sang tatlo ka miyembro sang panel sang independent experts para busision ang medikal nga kondisyon ni Duterte.
english: Atty. Conti, who also served as counsel for the victims of the former president's war on drugs, after the release of a document regarding the ICC Pre-Trial Chamber's appointment of three members of a panel of independent experts to investigate Duterte's medical condition.

text: Magapadayon man suno sa iya ang anay presidente sa kustodiya sang ICC kag pagatun-an ang kaso kada 120 days ukon kada apat ka bulan.
english: He said the former president will remain in the custody of the ICC and the case will be studied every 120 days or every four months.

text: Nagalaom man suno sa iya nga maisapinal ang mga kaso kag maumpisan ang hearing sa masunod nga tuig.
english: He said he hopes to finalize the cases and start the hearing next year.
